subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary after the current-main conflict is resolved?
rationale: The code path and proof are strong, but the PR intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility for waited A2A replies and cannot merge until its dirty head is reconciled with current main.

options.title: Accept Boundary After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the artifact-suppression boundary, rerun exact-head checks, and land if the QA proof remains green.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof

options.title: Pause For Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction duplicate work decided as one coordinated A2A delivery plan.
